text: If women keep putting you in a friend zone, you might be too much of a nice guy for them. Let's fix that. So today I want to talk about how not to be a nice guy. And I don't mean don't be respectful or polite. I mean stop being the type of a guy women see as a doormat instead of a man they respect and desire. First of all, dating should be like ping pong. You send the ball, you plan the date, text first, put in effort, she should send it back. If you're giving and giving but nothing comes back, that's not romance, that's charity. Stop playing alone. Second, keep your backbone. If she starts teasing you to do something you're uncomfortable with just to prove you're fun, you don't play along. You're not there to be her personal entertainment. You're a man with your own life and your own preferences. Third, boundaries matter. Stop chasing women who treat you like an option. If she's canceling last minute, taking days to reply, or always too busy, she's showing you exactly where you stand, at the bottom of her list. The nice guy ignores those signs. He keeps chasing, hoping she'll see how good he is. But here's the truth. Real life isn't a movie. You don't win respect by hanging around until she changes her mind. You win it by keeping your backbone and having clear boundaries.
